title: 第233章 问此间（六十一）
content_zh:
“我才是至恶，”心魔一字一句，独目中变化无穷的瞳孔,狰狞地扩张到整颗眼球，“我才是至恶！”
他早就是强弩之末，灯枯油尽之态，连瞎子也看得出来。他的神躯被心魔占夺，此刻的肉身，全然是靠神魂捏起来的残体。
不知为何,在这濒死之际,他听见心魔咬牙切齿的宣誓,内心唯余好笑。
以前的我，便如你一般，他嗬嗬地发出笑声,在心里如此想到,可是至恶的身份,又是什么值得拥有的好事吗？
晏欢全身上下,俱像个被打漏的血袋，汩汩潺潺地往外喷涌,他嘶哑地笑道：“一句话，说一遍……还不够有份量？”
心魔不敢，他也知道心魔不敢。融合本尊的神魂，无异于回到原点，他对回溯时光的渴望，能敌过晏欢对至善的爱吗？已经到了这一步，心魔万万不能赌这个可能性，至恶的劣根令他怯懦。
“你指望他来救你？”心魔冷冷问，“一个没了道心的至善，又有什么用处？”
这个仅有他和刘扶光知晓的秘密，只在晏欢脑海里一晃而过。明明已至垂死，他仍然感受到了一种浓郁、甜美的幸福，恶毒地盘踞在他的心尖。
“也许，你说得对，”他无所谓地笑道，“但不管他来，还是不来，我都快活。”
“所以，我不会让你太过称心如意。”他笑了一下，将手伸进胸膛，竟就此挖出了那颗漆黑跳动的龙心，朝晏欢蹲下。
飞越黑洞，穿过星星流泻的银河，刘扶光只身站在翻涌微尘的世界海，眼前恍如展开了万古长夜。
心魔的力量，已然深深影响到了周边的星辰，并且还有飞速扩散的趋势。
巫罗倾尽一世之力，为刘扶光治愈旧伤，虽然不能完全恢复，但仍令他重获穿越诸世的实力。遵循着神识的指引，他掠向全部黑暗的终点。
刘扶光不知道，他只能隐隐约约地猜测，为了夺取至恶的位置，将晏欢取而代之，他大约是可以做任何事的。
仿佛蛛网的圆心，他的视线里，出现了两个身影，一个立在高处，一个倒在下方。
“至善，”高处的心魔笑了起来，然而那笑容甚是古怪，“你来了。”
心魔咯咯地笑，就像个稚年的小女孩似的，他赞赏地说：“你们紧赶慢赶，九个锚点，叫你们拔去了一半，旱神固然未死，也能叫你一语驱逐……很出色的成绩！”
他站起来，化作一阵流连的黑雾，居然丝毫不惧，就此逼近了刘扶光。
蜷缩在地上的晏欢早已失去人形，仅是一团不辨四肢，不见头尾的肉块而已，没被打瞎的几颗眼珠淤肿难言，勉强转向刘扶光。
见心魔靠近，他发出吃力的喘息声，还想极力挣扎，被心魔袖中一鞭，直抽得黑血四溅。

刘扶光眼皮一跳，他从未见过晏欢沦落至此的惨状，掌心抽搐，不由自主地攥紧了长刀。
心魔察言观色，笑意溢于言表。游曳于世界海，他肆无忌惮地来到刘扶光耳边，想要轻佻地亲吻那如玉的耳垂，又被清气所阻。
“至善，你心疼啦？”心魔低语，“只可惜，这事却不得不让你亲自下手。能杀灭至恶的，也唯有至善了。”
饶至另一边，心魔的声音，像一匹流泻的蜂蜜，抑或散开的丝绸，甜腻诱惑得骇人。
“我知你良善，也知人族为你眷属，你爱他们，就像他们爱你一般……想想罢，扶光！好好想想。如今，我就以三千诸世，与你做了谈判的筹码。你杀晏欢，我便放过这些小世界，叫万千生灵得以活命，不被我所屠戮，不为你所连累。”
如雾流连的声音，犹如香炉泄地，一下弥漫得到处都是：“更何况，你是否忘记，我们都与晏欢有深仇大恨？他的痛苦催生出我，我生来何辜，为什么就要白白地承受这痛苦了？而你呢，他背叛你、害惨了你！他对你杀身取道，只为了满足一己私欲……你能放过他吗？不要被他蒙蔽呀，扶光！几句歉疚的好话，几滴眼泪，难道就让你忘了他的下贱之处吗？”
“杀了他。”心魔说，“只要你存有杀心，你是可以轻易杀了他的。我愿意放弃回转光阴的计划，只要你能杀了他。”
“那又有什么不好？”心魔激烈地反问，“我是干净的！扶光，我是干净的，我没有伤害过你。我的过去是一张白纸，只要你承认我的身份，我们就可以有一个崭新的开始。情天孽海、万般纠葛，都能一笔勾销，难道这不好么？”
心魔殷切地等待着他的回答，刘扶光则望向下方的晏欢，看见他湿漉漉地瑟缩着，从没有如此渺小，如此沉默，如此丑陋……如此脆弱过。
这下的力道，就像雪花飘转，落在一片叶子的尖端，但也让刘扶光踉跄着前进了一大步。
在他身后，心魔补充道：“一举两得，一箭双雕……世上再没有这么好的交易啦，扶光。去啊。”
刘扶光当真依他所说，慢慢走向晏欢。他松开刀柄，那黝黑的刀刃就悬浮在他身边，不住打着转。
他跪坐下去，因为实在无法分出身体构造，他便伸手下去，数千年来的第一次，他主动把晏欢抱在怀里，任由粘稠的黑血，染湿他雪白的衣袍。
content_en:
"I am the most evil," the inner demon said word by word, and the ever-changing pupil in his single eye dilated ferociously to cover the entire eyeball, "I am the most evil!"
He has long since reached the end of his strength and his lamp has run out of oil. Even a blind man can see that. His divine body was taken over by the inner demon, and his physical body at this moment was completely a broken body that was pinched by his divine soul.
For some reason, when he was on the verge of death, he heard the demon gnashing his teeth and swearing, and he was only amused in his heart.
I used to be just like you, he thought in his heart as he laughed hoarsely, but is the most evil identity a good thing worth having?
Yan Huan's whole body was like a leaked blood bag, gurgling out. He laughed hoarsely: "One sentence, said once... isn't it weighty enough?"
The inner demon doesn't dare, and he also knows that the inner demon doesn't dare. Fusion of the soul of this deity is tantamount to returning to the starting point. Can his desire to look back in time rival Yan Huan's love for the best? Having reached this point, the inner demon must not bet on this possibility. His evil roots make him cowardly.
"You expect him to save you?" The inner demon asked coldly, "What's the use of a good person who has no Taoist heart?"
This secret, which only he and Liu Fuguang knew, only flashed through Yan Huan's mind. Even though he was dying, he still felt a rich, sweet happiness, lingering viciously in his heart.
"Maybe you are right," he smiled indifferently, "but whether he comes or not, I will be happy."
"So, I won't let you get too satisfied with your wishes." He smiled, reached into his chest, dug out the dark beating dragon heart, and squatted down towards Yan Huan.
Flying over the black hole and passing through the Milky Way filled with stars, Liu Fuguang stood alone in the world sea of ​​surging dust, and it seemed like an eternal night unfolded before his eyes.
The power of the inner demon has deeply affected the surrounding stars, and it is also spreading rapidly.
Wu Luo devoted his whole life to healing Liu Fuguang's old wounds. Although he could not fully recover, he still regained the strength to travel through the worlds. Following the guidance of his divine consciousness, he flew towards the end of all darkness.
Liu Fuguang didn't know. He could only vaguely guess that in order to seize the position of the most evil and replace Yan Huan, he would probably do anything.
Like the center of a spider web, two figures appeared in his sight, one standing high and the other lying below.
"Supreme Goodness," the inner demon in the high place laughed, but the smile was very weird, "You are here."
The inner demon giggled, like a young girl, and said appreciatively: "You hurry up and hurry up, you have to pull out half of the nine anchor points. Although the drought god is not dead, he can also ask you to expel it with just one word... What an outstanding achievement!"
He stood up and turned into a lingering black mist. He was not afraid at all and approached Liu Fuguang.
Yan Huan, who was curled up on the ground, had long lost his human form. He was just a lump of flesh with no discernible limbs, head or tail. The few eyes that were not blinded were swollen and bruised, so he reluctantly turned to Liu Fuguang.
Seeing the inner demon approaching, he let out a labored gasp and tried to struggle, but was whipped by the inner demon's sleeve, causing black blood to splash everywhere.
Liu Fuguang's eyelids twitched. He had never seen Yan Huan in such a miserable state. His palms twitched and he involuntarily clenched the long knife.
The inner demon observes words and expressions, and smiles beyond words. Wandering in the sea of ​​​​the world, he came to Liu Fuguang's ear unscrupulously, wanting to kiss the jade-like earlobe frivolously, but was blocked by the clear air.
"Supreme Goodness, are you distressed?" The inner demon whispered, "It's a pity that you have to do this personally. The only one who can kill the most evil is the Supreme Good."
On the other side, the inner demon's voice is like a stream of honey or loose silk, frighteningly sweet and seductive.
"I know you are kind, and I also know that the human race is yours, and you love them just as they love you... Think about it, support the light! Think about it. Now,I used three thousand lifetimes as a bargaining chip with you. If you kill Yan Huan, I will let these small worlds go, so that thousands of creatures can survive and not be slaughtered by me or affected by you. "
The voice lingering like mist, like the incense burner leaking out, spread everywhere: "What's more, have you forgotten that we all have a deep hatred for Yan Huan? His pain gave birth to me. Why was I born? Why should I bear this pain in vain? And you, he betrayed you and caused you misery! He killed you just to satisfy his own selfish desires... Can you let him go? Don't be deceived by him, help the light! Could a few apologetic words and a few tears make you forget his despicableness? "
"Kill him. "The inner demon said, "As long as you have the intention to kill, you can easily kill him. I'm willing to give up my plan to turn back time if you can kill him. "
"What's wrong with that? The inner demon asked fiercely, "I am clean!" Fuguang, I am clean, I have not hurt you. My past is a blank piece of paper. As long as you acknowledge my identity, we can have a new beginning. Isn't it good that all the love, evil, and entanglements can be wiped out with one stroke? "
The inner demon was eagerly waiting for his answer, while Liu Fuguang looked down at Yan Huan and saw him shivering wetly. He had never been so small, so silent, so ugly...so fragile.
The force of this move was like snowflakes falling on the tip of a leaf, but it also made Liu Fuguang stagger forward a big step forward.
Behind him, the inner demon added: "Kill two birds with one stone, kill two birds with one stone... There is no such a good deal in the world, Fuguang. Go ahead. "
Liu Fuguang followed what he said and slowly walked towards Yan Huan. He let go of the handle of the knife, and the dark blade floated beside him, spinning constantly.
He knelt down and sat down. Because he couldn't distinguish the body structure, he reached down. For the first time in thousands of years, he took the initiative to hold Yan Huan in his arms, letting the thick black blood stain his snow-white robes.
